note: the quality scale is inverted, 200 - 2q below 50 and 5000 / q above, so high quality writes coarse tables, caught by JPEGWriteTests.qualityScale
the chroma table is used for luma, so Y is quantized and labelled with scaled K.2, caught by JPEGWriteTests.lumaTables
no byte stuffing: a coded 0xFF byte is not followed by 0x00, so the reader takes it for a marker, caught by JPEGWriteTests.noiseReopensAtHundred
no ZRL: a zero run over 15 is coded without its run-16 codes, caught by JPEGWriteTests.noiseReopensAtHundred
flush pads the last byte with 0-bits instead of 1-bits, caught by JPEGWriteTests.padsWithOnes
the quality guard only rejects 0, so 101 and negative qualities write a file, caught by JPEGWriteTests.qualityRange
the side guard drops the width check, so a frame wider than maxSide is written, caught by JPEGWriteTests.qualityRange
anchor: guard width <= maxSide, height <= maxSide else
